summary: Dreamland Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a private placement to its CEO/director, Ms. Seto Wai Yue, who purchased 580,000 Class A and 72,000 Class B shares at $3.75/share for $2.445 million gross proceeds. The transaction closed concurrent with the SPA, approved by disinterested directors. Issuance relied on Regulation S; Class B shares have 12 votes each. This insiders-only capital raise for working capital is a routine financing, not a special situation. No special-situation elements like control change or shareholder vote.
